prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1237; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene in Conroe, Texas, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right-hand lane of the roadway with visible contact damage to the left rear quarter panel of Vehicle 1 and the right front fender of Vehicle 2. Driver 1 stated that while attempting to change from the center lane into the right lane, the vehicle in the right lane moved into the same space, resulting in a sideswipe collision. Driver 2 stated they were in the right lane, had their turn signal activated, and did not see Driver 1 until contact occurred. Both drivers were cooperative. A Passenger in Vehicle 1 was present and declined medical evaluation. Driver 1 reported pain and stiffness in the lower back following the impact and was transported by EMS for further evaluation. No citations were issued at the scene pending review of the statements. Traffic flow was partially restricted until both vehicles were moved to the shoulder. Photographs were taken and are attached to this report.
